::: {.callout-note title="Statement of Inquiry · 单元探究命题" icon=false}
**Human communities turned unpredictable river environments into the world's first cities, and the solutions they invented — from irrigation to writing to laws — became the foundation of civilization.** \
*([当人类社群把难以预料的河流环境改造成世界上最早的城市时，他们发明的解决方案——从灌溉、书写到法律——便奠定了人类文明的根基。]{.zh})*

**Key Concept:** Time, Place, and Space (时间、地点与空间) · **Related Concepts:** Civilization, Causality, Governance, Culture · **Global Context:** Orientation in Space and Time
:::
